$comment: Labs whose Learn drift warning was triaged as a search-ranking false positive: the cited pages still resolve and are the right pages, but a broad search ranks other pages first. Fix the lab first; add an entry here only after triage, with a reason. Update verifiedAt whenever the list is re-checked. The monthly audit asks for a re-triage once verifiedAt is older than DRIFT_BASELINE_MAX_AGE_DAYS (default 90).

reasons.22-servicenow-integration: Generic ServiceNow query favors Microsoft 365 and Security Copilot integrations over the valid Power Platform ServiceNow connector reference.
reasons.23-snowflake-data-integration: Generic Snowflake query favors Copilot Studio security pages over the valid Snowflake (v2) connector and VNet references.
reasons.30-realtime-voice-agents: Generic voice/telephony search favors classic NLU and omnichannel pages over the valid real-time voice agent references.
